findings.title: Kiroween 2026 displays $100,000 cash breakdown; binding rules still unavailable
findings.prize_breakdown: 1st $30k; 2nd $20k; 3rd $10k; four category awards $5k each; startup $10k; Ghost of Kiroween Past $2k; Kiro Crew App $1k; four student-category awards $1.5k each; Best Demo $1k; sum $100k.
findings.entry_cost: not independently verified against binding 2026 rules
findings.eligibility: Devpost overview says adults in permitted jurisdictions; final rules not yet posted
findings.requirements: new Kiro-created project only; organizer explicitly says do not begin before submission period opens
findings.confidence: high for advertised cash breakdown, low for binding eligibility/payout
findings.next_action: After the official rules publish on October 30, reconcile prize amounts, eligibility, submission/start time, cost and restrictions; only then consider canonical intelligence and a structured case. Do not begin work on entry early.
findings.deduplication: Kiroween already screened as rules-pending in Oct 27 research; this pass verifies prize breakdown without duplicate promotion.

findings.title: CARI: Cross-Boundary Adversarial Runtime Injection in Coding-Agent Workflows
findings.authors_claim: 2,845 of 3,000 trials (94.8%) in their controlled setting, with product-agent transfer rates 61.3% and 58.7%; results not independently reproduced
findings.relevance: high for multi-agent integration and CI/tool-output trust
findings.next_action: Assess overlap with tool-evidence-deference case from PR #223, and design isolated synthetic runtime-log/CI-output trust-boundary fixtures; do not run attacks on external targets; check license before importing artifacts.

findings.title: Judging Before Propagation: Task-Graph Contextual Integrity for Multi-Agent Privacy
findings.authors_claim: MAPLE-Bench 144 cases; mean unauthorized disclosures reduced 85.8-94.1% in the authors' primary setup; not independently reproduced
findings.relevance: high for multi-agent provenance and integration queue privacy
findings.next_action: Compare propagation-scoped policies with existing agent integration boundaries on synthetic data; verify license and independent reproducibility before adopting.

findings.title: Understanding and Mitigating Role Spoofing in LLMs
findings.authors_claim: Studies structural and content-based role confusion; proposes linear-probe detection; performance not independently reproduced
findings.relevance: useful for separating untrusted tool output from agent instructions
findings.next_action: Deduplicate against PR #223 tool-evidence work and PR #224 human-approval research; evaluate defensive synthetic fixtures only.
